upheld.title: /item/not-found can be opened directly and answers 200
upheld.detail: ItemNotFound needs its own route to serve as the router's NotFoundPage. Opening that route directly renders the 'Not found' product page with status 200, so the not-found page is reachable as a normal page without a 404.
upheld.requirement: /item/0 and /item/-1 answer exactly as /item/999999 does: status 404 and the same page

upheld.title: Back link markup and its scoped CSS duplicated across ItemPage and ItemNotFound
upheld.detail: The .item-page, .item-back, .item-back:hover and .item-back img rules are copied from ItemPage.razor.css into ItemNotFound.razor.css, and the back-link anchor markup appears in both components. upheld.requirement: No duplicated logic (pr-check-style 'What to check' 2); implementer.md UI row: shared components keep their styles in *.razor.css next to the component

upheld.title: Coverage gap: The design critic's coverage marks 'Rendered visuals (frames)' as unverifiable because no readable videos exist for this round, and no findi
upheld.detail: The design critic's coverage marks 'Rendered visuals (frames)' as unverifiable because no readable videos exist for this round, and no finding covers it. CLAUDE.md requires a passing e2e test with its video for user-visible changes.

dismissed.title: Back-link and page container styles copied into a second scoped stylesheet
dismissed.reason: Duplicate of STY-1-1 (same evidence, same fix), which is upheld. The critic withdrew it.

dismissed.title: New not-found page sets no PageTitle
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn. On main the not-found branch set no PageTitle, so the page matches the reference page the ticket names. A tab title is an enhancement the story does not ask for.

dismissed.title: Item-specific ItemNotFound is wired as the app-wide router NotFoundPage
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn. src/WebApp has no UseStatusCodePages re-execute, so URLs that match no @page never reach the Router. The only NavigationManager.NotFound() caller is ItemPage, and ItemNotFound.razor:5 documents its role.

dismissed.title: SetNotFound is a one-line pass-through to Nav.NotFound()
dismissed.reason: A preference. The one-line private wrapper gives the comment explaining why Nav.NotFound() is used instead of setting StatusCode one place to live, and it is called from two places. It affects no result and no maintenance surface.
